test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

Reena said to Rhea, “I will not accompany you on this trip.”

options.text: Reena said to Rhea that she will not accompany her on the trip.
Reena said to Rhea that she will not accompany her on this trip.
Reena told Rhea that she would not accompany her on that trip.
Reena said to Rhea that she will not be accompanying her on this trip.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Reena told Rhea that she would not accompany her on that trip."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given interrogative sentence is in the future tense and direct speech.
 
• The rules of Direct and Indirect speech for negative sentence conversions.
 
 
• Inverted commas are removed in indirect speech. 
 
• The reporting verb said/said to is changed to "told, asked, demanded, ordered, enquired" as per the nature of the sentence.
 
• The first person in the reported speech changes according to the subject of the reporting speech.
 
• In Reported Speech change of the second person depends on the object of reporting speech.
 
• The third person remains unchanged.
 
• "Will" changes to "would."
 
• Structure__: 
 
 
• Subject + will not + V1+ Object (Direct Speech)
 
• Subject + would not + V1 + Object ) (Indirect Speech)
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *He said to Rahul "You will not help me"*
 
• *He told Rahul that he would not help me.*
 
 
 
 
 
• *​*Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

 

Correct sentence:* "Reena told Rhea that she would not accompany her on that trip.*
